easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 2 or greater.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Inferno Project enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
